spatial_model.output_a_source_lattice: even row / even column in pointer-relative difference coordinates
spatial_model.output_b_source_lattice: odd row / odd column in pointer-relative difference coordinates
spatial_model.known_sample: difference at the same pointer-relative coordinate
spatial_model.horizontal: signed 16-bit saturating sum of left/right known samples, arithmetic shift right 1
spatial_model.vertical: signed 16-bit wrapping sum of top/bottom known samples, arithmetic shift right 1
spatial_model.diagonal: horizontal saturated averages on top and bottom rows, then signed 16-bit wrapping sum, arithmetic shift right 1
spatial_model.final: signed 16-bit wrapping green-plus-difference, then signed clamp to 0..16383
